استغفرت (form X)
# اِسْتَغْفَرْتُ (istaḡfartu) /is.taɣ.far.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَغْفَرَ (istaḡfara)
# اِسْتَغْفَرْتَ (istaḡfarta) /is.taɣ.far.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَغْفَرَ (istaḡfara)
# اِسْتَغْفَرْتِ (istaḡfarti) /is.taɣ.far.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَغْفَرَ (istaḡfara)
# اِسْتَغْفَرَتْ (istaḡfarat) /is.t
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
